title: 6.18.2 Sub-build: Out and gone
description: One stone, one list, one sweep. Remove what leaves the screen from both places.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: One stone flies off the right edge and the list keeps counting up.

steps.title: Sweep it
steps.instructions: Loop from the end of `shots`: when a stone is off the screen, `delete()` it and `splice(i, 1)`.
hints: Both calls, in the same branch.
Loop backwards: `for (let i = shots.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)`.

steps.title: Check the count
steps.instructions: Show `shots.length` on screen: it should fall to 0 after the stone leaves, not climb for ever.

requirements.title: Two removals
requirements.description: A spent shot is deleted and spliced in the same branch. Help: 6.18.1 (Reading: Out and gone)

requirements.title: Backwards
requirements.description: The sweep runs from the end of the array. Help: 6.18.1 (Reading: Out and gone)
